title: The DATEDIF function: the gap between two dates
summary: DATEDIF works out the gap between two dates in years, months or days.
intro: `DATEDIF` works out the time between a start date and an end date in the unit you choose: `"y"` for whole years, `"m"` for months and `"d"` for days. The start date must come before the end date.
args: The unit: `"y"`, `"m"` or `"d"`, or `"ym"` and `"md"` for what is left after the years or months.
errors: The start date is after the end date, or the unit is unknown.

faq.q: Why doesn't DATEDIF appear in the function list?
faq.a: It is an old function that Excel supports without suggesting it as you type, but it works when you type it in full.
